listing.name: Kirby and the Forgotten Land (nxport)
listing.summary: Use the nxport builder and your own extracted Kirby and the Forgotten Land files to create a Mac or iOS app. The project reports testing both platforms, with invisible exhale effects and rounded shadows. It has no ready-made player.

steps.title: Check your original game files
steps.instruction: Provide your own extracted ExeFS, RomFS and Logo. The exact tested version, region and title ID are unconfirmed.

steps.title: Follow the project’s setup
steps.instruction: Build nxport-builder from source, choose Kirby and the Forgotten Land and select the Mac or iOS target to produce a local app or IPA. You handle setup and later rebuilds.

references.title: Version and platform notes
references.instruction: The builder targets Apple silicon. The project has not confirmed a Windows or Linux player.

source_editions.title: Kirby and the Forgotten Land (Nintendo Switch)
